address: Station Road, Buxted, Near Uckfield, East Sussex,TN22 4AY
bio: Set in the heart of 312 lush acres, Buxted Park is a glorious country hotel providing the perfect setting for the ultimate Afternoon Tea indulgence.  Built in 1722 by Sir Thomas Medley, Buxted Park Hotel's history is as colourful as it is long. The Grade II listed Palladian mansion, set in the finest parkland and the award-winning 2 AA Rosette dining, makes Buxted Park Hotel the ideal location to relax or celebrate.  The surroundings may be grand but that doesn’t mean a hushed reverence is encouraged. This great country house was built for pleasure, The Crystal Bar and Coat of Arms Lounge are special features of any visit to Buxted Park. Featuring decorative high ceilings, ornate chandeliers, full height windows with far reaching views of the estate and comfortable leather furniture, all serve to create a sense of grandeur, but one which will not stifle your occasion.  One of the most memorable experiences of Afternoon Tea East Sussex has to offer; you’ll be invited to sit down to a selection of delicious sweet and savoury treats served in one of the stunning lounges or on the terrace overlooking 300 acres of finest Ashdown Forest parkland.  Buxted Park Hotel is located in between Buxted and Uckfield, just a short distance from Buxted Station.
